title: Electric Service Agreement Reconnection Charge for Households Receiving Energy Assistance — Decision Card
content:
**Decision rule.** The reconnection charge on an Electric Service Agreement is multiplied by a hardship share of one half (0.5) when the agreement received two or more payments from an energy assistance agency in the assistance window, three quarters (0.75) when it received exactly one such payment there, and one when it received none. The share multiplies the reconnection charge before it is rounded; only the final reconnection charge is rounded to the cent.

**Payments counted.** Payments posted to the agreement through the energy assistance agency channel and dated within the assistance window, which is counted back from the order date.

| Agency payments in the assistance window | Hardship share | Hypothetical charge of 140.00 USD becomes |
|---|---|---|
| 2 or more | 0.5 | 70.00 |
| exactly 1 | 0.75 | 105.00 |
| none | 1 | 140.00 |

**Either side of each line.** One payment gives 0.75 and a second gives 0.5; with no payment in the window the charge is not reduced. A payment dated before the assistance window does not count.
